subject: Walkling Court Redevelopment Funding
overview: The committee deliberated on final Community Preservation Act funding for 2022, primarily focusing on a housing authority redevelopment project. The body voted to recommend significant pre-development funding for Walkling Court while planning for its upcoming annual public hearing and streamlining future application processes.

items.title: Walkling Court Phase 1 Funding
items.summary: Approved recommending $800,000 for Phase 1 pre-development costs of the Walkling Court housing redevelopment project as a forgivable loan. The award is contingent on receiving requisite zoning approvals to create 54 new affordable housing units on the site.

items.title: Pending 2022 Project Deliberations
items.summary: Determined that remaining funds were insufficient to support the Brooks Estate Manor, Salem Street Burial Ground, and Tufts Park projects in the current cycle, despite the committee's general interest in funding them in the future.

items.title: Annual Review and Public Hearing Planning
items.summary: Scheduled the annual public hearing for April 11, 2023, and discussed streamlining the next application cycle by removing the eligibility determination step to reduce administrative burden during staffing transitions.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes for November 30, 2022, December 13, 2022, and January 10, 2023.
